# Lumen

> Lumen is an evidence-first health and medical-technology news publication. Every story is graded against a documented five-point editorial standard (source tier, trial phase, reported patient numbers, absolute effect size, disease burden) before publication. Author and publisher: Nathan Stanley Martanegara.

Lumen content may be cited with attribution to Lumen (https://readlumen.site). Figures are reported in absolute terms; corrections are logged publicly.

- Homepage: https://readlumen.site/

## Stories
- [A twice-yearly shot cut new HIV infections to near zero in trials, and is now reaching Africa.](https://readlumen.site/story/lenacapavir-twice-yearly-hiv-prevention): Twice-yearly lenacapavir prevented nearly all HIV infections in two phase 3 trials and won FDA approval in 2025. Access, not efficacy, is now the limit.
- [A GLP-1 drug slowed biological-aging markers in the first randomized human evidence.](https://readlumen.site/story/semaglutide-epigenetic-aging-glp-1): First randomized human evidence: semaglutide slowed DNA "aging clocks" (PhenoAge −4.9 yrs) — but a post-hoc analysis in adults with HIV, not proof of longer lif
- [The first FDA-approved gene therapy for inherited deafness improved hearing in most treated children](https://readlumen.site/story/otarmeni-otof-gene-therapy-inherited-deafness): The FDA gave accelerated approval to the first gene therapy for inherited (OTOF) deafness; 80% of evaluable children gained hearing.
- [A new brain stimulation therapy matched ECT for severe depression with less memory loss](https://readlumen.site/story/magnetic-seizure-therapy-ect-depression-memory): A large head-to-head trial found magnetic seizure therapy eased severe depression about as often as ECT (~48% each), with less memory loss.
- [84% of patients on a weekly survodutide shot cut liver fat in a phase 3 trial](https://readlumen.site/story/survodutide-synchronize-masld-liver-fat): Phase 3 trial: weekly survodutide cut liver fat in 84% of MASLD patients vs 24% on placebo. It measured liver fat, not long-term liver damage.
- [Tracked from 70 to 100: a simple "intrinsic capacity" score predicted who survived longest](https://readlumen.site/story/intrinsic-capacity-score-longevity-70-100): A 30-year study tracking adults from 70 to 100 found a simple "intrinsic capacity" score — cognition, mood, vitality, movement, senses — predicted survival.
- [Scientists found a hidden T-cell "brake" called SLAMF6 — and antibodies that release it](https://readlumen.site/story/slamf6-t-cell-brake-cancer-immunotherapy): Researchers identified SLAMF6, a hidden brake that exhausts cancer-fighting T cells, and built antibodies to release it — boosting tumor attacks in mice.
- [1 protein switched off made CAR-T cells fight tumors longer — a possible fix for solid cancers](https://readlumen.site/story/nfil3-off-switch-car-t-solid-tumors): Scientists disabled a protein called NFIL3 and made CAR-T cells fight tumors longer in mice — a possible breakthrough for hard-to-treat solid cancers.
- [An AI-designed universal coronavirus vaccine just passed its first human trial](https://readlumen.site/story/an-ai-designed-universal-coronavirus-vaccine-just-passed-its-first-human-trial): An AI-designed universal coronavirus vaccine from Cambridge passed its first human trial, showing safety and broad immune responses against SARS-CoV-2 and SARS.
- [A single nutrient reversed signs of cellular aging — and it's already in your food.](https://readlumen.site/story/nutrient-reverses-cellular-aging-phosphatidylcholine): A nutrient in everyday food reversed signs of cellular aging in new research, restoring youthful mitochondrial energy by replenishing phosphatidylcholine.
- [20 years of work yields a compound that blocks a new Alzheimer's target and extends lifespan in mice](https://readlumen.site/story/alzheimers-compound-10-grk2-new-target): ETH Zurich scientists found a compound that blocks GRK2, a new Alzheimer's target, slowing brain-cell death and extending lifespan in mice.
- [The child who can now hold a conversation she was born unable to have](https://readlumen.site/story/gene-therapy-hearing-dfnb9-otof-children): A single gene-therapy injection restored hearing in five of six children born deaf from an OTOF mutation. Two can now hold a conversation.
- [An AI spotted pancreatic cancer three years before diagnosis — on scans doctors had called normal](https://readlumen.site/story/ai-pancreatic-cancer-ct-early-detection-3years): An AI trained on 24,000 CT scans flagged pancreatic cancer a mean three years before diagnosis — on scans radiologists had called normal. Validation underway.
- [Synthetic mRNA told a damaged heart to repair itself — the first human signal that it works](https://readlumen.site/story/mrna-heart-repair-vegf-post-mi-azd8601): In a 24-patient Nature trial, VEGF-A mRNA injected into damaged heart muscle improved pumping function at three months. A signal that mRNA can drive repairs.
- [The swallowable camera that made the colonoscopy optional](https://readlumen.site/story/swallowable-capsule-endoscopy-colorectal-pillcam): The PillCam Colon 2 capsule detected 88% of significant polyps with no sedation or prep in a 968 patient NEJM trial now FDA-approved as colonoscopy alternative.
